bahrain_fort.name: Bahrain Fort (Qal'at al-Bahrain)
bahrain_fort.price_text: Free entry to the site and small on-site museum
bahrain_fort.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00; check on the day
bahrain_fort.tip: Go early morning or late afternoon for cooler air and soft light on the ruins.
bahrain_fort.best: Early morning or late afternoon; avoid midday heat

al_fateh_mosque.name: Al Fateh Grand Mosque
al_fateh_mosque.price_text: Free entry; guided tours usually free
al_fateh_mosque.hours: Open to visitors most days outside prayer times; check on the day
al_fateh_mosque.tip: Women should cover hair, arms and legs; abayas are often available at the entrance.
al_fateh_mosque.best: Morning or late afternoon, outside prayer times

bab_al_bahrain.name: Bab Al Bahrain
bab_al_bahrain.hours: Exterior always visible; interior hours vary
bab_al_bahrain.tip: Use it as your gateway marker before walking into the souq behind it.

manama_souq.name: Manama Souq
manama_souq.price_text: Free to wander; pay per purchase
manama_souq.hours: Busiest late afternoon and evening; many shops closed midday
manama_souq.tip: Bargain politely and carry small cash for spices, fabrics and snacks.

beit_al_quran.name: Beit Al Quran
beit_al_quran.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
beit_al_quran.hours: Usually open daytime, closed Fridays; check on the day
beit_al_quran.tip: Look for the rare manuscripts and calligraphy; allow a quiet hour.

arad_fort.name: Arad Fort
arad_fort.hours: Daytime hours; check on the day
arad_fort.tip: Pair it with nearby Muharraq walks and the Pearling Path.

adhari_park.name: Adhari Park
adhari_park.price_text: Park entry often free; rides ticketed; check on the day
adhari_park.hours: Afternoon and evening hours; check on the day
adhari_park.tip: Good for families with kids; confirm ride opening times before you go.
adhari_park.best: Late afternoon and evening; cooler months

pearling_path.name: Pearling Path
pearling_path.price_text: Free to walk; some houses ticketed
pearling_path.hours: Outdoor route always open; houses have daytime hours
pearling_path.tip: Walk it in the cooler evening and stop at the restored merchant houses.
pearling_path.best: Late afternoon into evening; cooler months

souq_food_stalls.name: Manama Souq food stalls and cafés
souq_food_stalls.tip: Try local snacks and fresh juice; prices are low and portions are generous.

bahrain_national_museum.name: Bahrain National Museum
bahrain_national_museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
bahrain_national_museum.hours: Daytime, closed some days; check on the day
bahrain_national_museum.tip: Good air-conditioned stop in the heat; covers Dilmun and pearling history.

seef_mall.name: Seef Mall and Seef district walk
seef_mall.price_text: Free to enter; pay per purchase
seef_mall.hours: Malls usually 10:00–22:00; check on the day
seef_mall.tip: Escape the heat for shopping and cafés, then walk the waterfront nearby.

juffair_cafes.name: Juffair café and restaurant strip
juffair_cafes.hours: Mostly evening; some open all day
juffair_cafes.tip: Lively dinner area with many cuisines; book on weekends.

corniche_walk.name: Manama Corniche waterfront walk
corniche_walk.tip: Walk at sunset for sea views and cooler air.

dhow_cruise.name: Evening dhow cruise
dhow_cruise.price_text: Varies by operator; check on booking
dhow_cruise.tip: Confirm what is included (dinner, drinks) and the meeting point before booking.

muharraq_walk.name: Muharraq old town walk
muharraq_walk.tip: Combine with the Pearling Path houses for a half-day of history.
